## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md exists with required item fields (stable_id, type, location, page, validation_rule) documented
- dd-2: contract defines a controlled `page` identifier vocabulary or vocabulary-definition mechanism
- dd-5: contract document includes at least one passing example and one failing example with the rejection reason

## Description
Author `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md` following the shape of `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/external-dependencies-block.md`. Document:
- markdown section header `## Copy Needs`
- `schema_version: 1` line at section top
- required per-item fields (stable_id, type, location, page, validation_rule) with descriptions
- controlled `page` identifier vocabulary as an inline enumerated list
- vocabulary extension procedure (PR to this file)
- one passing example
- one failing example annotated with rejection reason

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=bash --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/ || true
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh || true
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh || true
- [ ] Contract doc exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md
- [ ] Doc includes `## Copy Needs` header
  Verify: grep -q '^## Copy Needs' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md
- [ ] Doc documents all five required item fields
  Verify: for f in stable_id type location page validation_rule; do grep -q "$f" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Doc defines controlled page vocabulary section
  Verify: grep -qiE 'page (vocabulary|identifiers)' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md
- [ ] Doc documents vocab extension procedure
  Verify: grep -qiE 'extension|extend|adding a new page' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md
- [ ] Doc includes passing and failing examples
  Verify: grep -qiE 'passing example|valid example' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md && grep -qiE 'failing example|invalid example|rejection reason' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md: Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
